name: Innovassynth Investments Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2008, Innovassynth Investments Ltd is a holding and investment company
keyPoints:
Business Associate:[1][2][3]
Company invested in Innovassynth Technologies (India) Limited (~31.79%), which is its Associate from 12 February 2022. ITIL is R&D and technology-based Organization engaged in developing, scaling up and manufacturing of specialty chemicals and pharmaceutical Intermediates. Key focus business areas are customs synthesis, contract research & manufacturing of specialty chemicals, toll manufacture of chemicals and similar businesses. It also supplies protected nucleosides and modified phosphonamidites used for clinical, diagnostic and therapeutic oligonucleotides applications. On 12th February  2022, Managing Director of Innovassynth Technologies Ltd was appointed as Managing Director of company resulting into establishment of significant influence over ITIL. Company has not diversified its investment in other entities except ITIL
